sections.label: Hospital beds and healthcare workforce
sections.summary: By 2030 Singapore expects 2,800 more hospital beds, six new polyclinics, 10,000 nursing home beds, and a 20% larger healthcare workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: By 2030, we expect to add 2,800 acute and community hospital beds, a 25% increase, through the new Eastern General Hospital and the redevelopment of Alexandra Hospital.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Within this timeframe, we aim to open six new polyclinics in Bidadari, Kaki Bukit, Serangoon, Tengah, Yew Tee and Taman Jurong, and another 10,000 nursing home beds.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Beyond 2030, we will open a new general and community hospital in Tengah and redevelop both the Singapore General Hospital and National University Hospital campuses.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: To support capacity expansion, MOH will grow the healthcare workforce by another 20% by 2030, while broadening and deepening its expertise.

sections.label: Precision medicine and AI
sections.summary: MOH will make imaging AI a national capability by end-2026, launch an AI assistant on HealthHub, and introduce AI for predictive and preventive care.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Precision medicine and artificial intelligence (AI) form a powerful and promising combination.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We will make imaging AI a national capability in public healthcare by end-2026, launch an AI assistant on the consolidated HealthHub app and progressively introduce AI for predictive and preventive care, so that we can intervene early to delay or prevent the onset of serious illnesses.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: MOH has seen good progress with Healthier SG so far, with over 1.3 million residents enrolled.

sections.label: Over-servicing and care shift
sections.summary: MOH will transform the health care system to shift care delivery away from acute hospitals to the community, especially for preventive care and population health.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Over-servicing and unnecessary treatments have led to significant wastage and rising costs in private healthcare, made worse by overly generous health insurance policies, especially riders.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: MOH will drive the transformation of our health care system to significantly shift care delivery away from acute hospitals to the community, especially for preventive care and population health, enabled by investments in manpower transformation and technology.
